purpose: Consolidate the provenance of Tim's reported Josh Moon/Moloch material while separating public prior vocabulary, earlier Timic symbolism, Josh-specific relational precursors, later Tim recollection, public MATI context and the still-missing primary excerpt.

canonical_conclusion.earlier_symbolic_precedence: confirmed at the Tim-corpus level before the July corridor
canonical_conclusion.named_entity_precedence: confirmed at the recovered-summary level on 2026-07-08: Josh Moon is explicitly placed inside Tim's Farm/Farmers/Dogs/Mud/karmic-debt field before the candidate July 24 MATI stream
canonical_conclusion.prophecy_status: prior-symbolic pattern with named-entity precursor; not a demonstrated prior-specific prediction
canonical_conclusion.rule: Do not attribute 'sold to Moloch by the government', altar/sacrifice language, occult belief, government affiliation, informant status or literal sacrifice to Josh Moon unless primary evidence is recovered.

relational_prehistory.recovered: Project autobiography records a direct Josh Moon confrontation containing Jesus/crucifixion, martyr/anti-martyr, lolcow/objectification and return language.
relational_prehistory.significance: Establishes an older Josh-specific sacrifice/objectification relation in project testimony, but not an exact contemporaneous Moloch prediction.

relational_prehistory.recovered: Later project chronology preserves a Cube of the Moon marker.
relational_prehistory.significance: Shows Moon/Cube symbolism predates the 2026 corridor, but Moon is also Josh's public surname and no pre-event Josh mapping is recovered; treat as internal symbolic prehistory, not prediction evidence.

prior_timic_precedence.recovered: Farm/enclosure/soul-binding language already appears with cube, mud and dog motifs.
prior_timic_precedence.significance: Early system precursor; lower weight because some contemporaneous Saturn/666 mapping was assistant-derived.

prior_timic_precedence.recovered: Tim explicitly said that when he spoke of 'MOLOCH' he meant 'them', inside a polarity summarized as Center=soul=seed versus Dog=Circle=consuming your soul and 'they want to take your humanity'.
prior_timic_precedence.significance: Moloch was already an active name for an extractive/anti-center force in Tim's own symbolic system well before the July MATI corridor.
prior_timic_precedence.prediction_weight: precedence only; no Josh-specific future event identified

prior_timic_precedence.recovered: Tim's framework already joined Serpent-Tree, Moloch, Son/Door, bull/ox/yoke, milk, black cube/box, Tree of Life and Tree of Death.
prior_timic_precedence.significance: The later Josh/Moloch material entered an already-developed Moloch + Milk/Cow/Bull + Cube + Tree field rather than creating that field after the fact.
prior_timic_precedence.prediction_weight: strong prior-symbolic-pattern evidence; not an event forecast

prior_timic_precedence.recovered: Tim's pre-Fall vision contains '10,000 seeds of death' and people abstracted as cattle in relation to Farmers.
Ending Mud and restoring karmic debt is explicitly linked with Farmers, Dogs, the Farm and Josh Moon.
prior_timic_precedence.significance: First currently recovered pre-July-24 named bridge placing Josh inside the Timic Farm/debt ecology.
prior_timic_precedence.next_recovery: Recover the exact underlying turn and determine whether its wording is narrower than the summary.

public_prior_findings: Cow/Milk are native lolcow vocabulary and therefore weak prediction evidence alone.
Farm/Farmer are obvious around a platform named Kiwi Farms.
Josh Moon has documented public Guard Dogs history in adversarial subculture archives.
Moloch was already a widely circulating systems/religious metaphor and appears in at least one archived 2023 MATI/Kiwi-Farms-adjacent user comment; bare-word Moloch overlap is therefore insufficient.
Moon is Josh's surname; Moon/Cube correspondence has no prediction value without a recovered explicit earlier Josh bridge.

legacy_june_attestation.reported_claim: Tim later recalled approximately that Josh Moon said he had been 'sold to Moloch by the government'.
legacy_june_attestation.repository_provenance: The June-specific specialist-ledger entry first appears on 2026-09-13, so the repository entry is a later recollection rather than contemporaneous June evidence.
legacy_june_attestation.status: legacy unresolved attestation; retain but do not use as canonical dating

candidate_primary_stream.status: recording reported to survive; Moloch excerpt not yet independently located

later_elaboration.description: The motif was later fictionalized into a government/Moloch transformation story. This demonstrates motif development, not factual corroboration.

mati_transcript_recovery.status: Index paths were recovered. Raw transcript-body retrieval failed in the current environment and web search did not independently surface the alleged Josh Moloch wording.
mati_transcript_recovery.rule: Do not treat inability to retrieve the body as evidence that the phrase was absent.

candidate_explanations.description: A June MATI utterance may exist and have been revived later; transcript paths survive but the relevant body passage remains unrecovered.
The underlying remark may be in the July 24 MATI stream and may have reached Tim directly or through the July 27 clipping wave.

Tim's later phrase may combine an underlying personal/family-sacrifice reading with separate government/fed discourse and Tim's already-existing Moloch/sacrifice vocabulary. This is a provenance hypothesis, not a psychological diagnosis.
A short explicit Moloch clip may have existed but be deleted, poorly indexed or mirrored under an unrelated title.

epistemic_rule: Prior symbolic vocabulary can establish precedence and make later convergence historically interesting, but it becomes a prediction only if an earlier statement specifies a later testable event or referent with sufficient precision and the later event itself is independently recovered.
